verdict.rationale: Shortcut presents itself as a place to direct coding agents ('idea to spec to PR', tracking work from people and agents), so reviewing agent output is a fair question for it. However, the evidence never shows a mobile app, line-level code review comments, or a loop where the agent iterates on review feedback. GitHub integration and agent connections via MCP are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can review AI agent code changes and comment on specific lines from a mobile app, then have the agent iterate
